item.description:

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in CO₂ laser synthesis of ternary NiCoCu borate nanosheets in just 1 min, far faster than conventional methods. This catalyst achieves a high NH₃ yield (4.1 mg h⁻¹ cm⁻²) and 90.69% Faradaic efficiency for nitrate reduction, with mechanistic insight from in situ/ex situ spectroscopy and DFT. Significance: it enables efficient nitrate-to-ammonia electrosynthesis and durable Zn–NO₃⁻ batteries (1.44 V open-circuit voltage).

💡 The novelty lies in a pre-embedded CNT framework that spatially separates carbon functions—KB for sulfur hosting/short-range transfer and CNTs as a long-range conducting skeleton—outperforming loading- and bridging-type designs. item.title: Facet/Interphase Dual Engineering of Zn Anodes via Silicotungstic Acid Etching for Highly Reversible Aqueous Zinc‐Ion Batteries
item.description:

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Single-step silicotungstic acid etching simultaneously engineers Zn facet and interphase: it exposes Zn(101) facets and forms a Keggin [SiW12O40]4−-rich layer. This dual engineering raises Zn2+ transference (0.38→0.62), lowers desolvation energy (38.70→28.51 kJ/mol), suppresses side reactions, and enables >3100 h cycling with 97.95% CE. It offers a practical one-step route to reversible Zn anodes.
